cases.title: Irkutsk laboratory-worker death evidence tracker
cases.question: What is publicly established about the death of a worker at an Irkutsk infectious-disease research institute, and do the available records establish plague, an occupational pathogen link, a laboratory accident, a second plague case, or a second death?

period.scope: Four targeted query groups covering WHO/IHR; Russian contacts/quarantine/investigation; institution procurement/budget/regulation/patents/licensing; independent interviews. Three webpage opens (WHO,ECDC,RPN). No new independent clinical, investigation, contract-performance or rights evidence verified. October8 announcement/by-October9 completion remain scoped dependent statements; no population equivalence inferred.

cases.title: Non-squamous NSCLC in China
cases.question: What published evidence and aggregate data gaps are decision-relevant across distinct clinical contexts?

period.scope: Sunday limited PubMed/NMPA screen of population, clinical evidence, regulatory state and aggregate outcomes. Index-cohort trial abstract read; two regulator originals unavailable. Squamous studies excluded; no broad review of every modality claimed. No individual prognosis, recommendation or identifiable patient record collected; ECMO remains life support, not cancer therapy.

period.scope: Bounded sodium commissioning/delivery search and CATL original. No new qualifying evidence in scope. Previously recorded Moonwatt candidate remains subject to human review; this refresh does not resolve that gate.

period.scope: Bounded 800V/SST official-source and field-deployment search; Sungrow original read and live site/snapshot independently checked. No newly qualifying independently attributable field operation, replication or reliability record found in scope.
